notes: One prompt, one build. Published at still-point-studio.lovable.app — the plain name 'still-point' was already taken, so Lovable added the suffix on its own. No confirmation email is sent: the app states on the confirmation screen that email sending needs a paid plan and a verified domain, which satisfies A6 as written. The admin page is open to anyone by design, as the brief asked. Lovable also reported its own 390 px check in the chat; we verified it independently and it passed.
